background.value: White background required; the applicant's signature must be affixed below the photo on the application form

glasses_policy.value: No eyeglasses/spectacles should be worn in the photo — stricter than the passport rule, which permits untinted prescription glasses.

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, both eyes visible, mouth closed, facing the camera directly (not portrait-style at an angle).

headwear_policy.value: Head coverings are not accepted, except where the competent State authority specifically approves for religious, medical, or cultural reasons.

face_visibility.value: Face must occupy 70-80% of the photo's length; applicant must face square to the camera (not at an angle) with both edges of the face clearly visible.

accessories.value: The photo must show the applicant alone, with no other people or objects visible.

file_spec.value: For e-Visa online applications: digital passport-sized photo in JPG format, validated via the portal's built-in 'Check Your Photo' tool.

glasses.en: No eyeglasses or spectacles should be worn in the photo — stricter than the passport rule, which permits untinted prescription glasses.
glasses.ko: 여권 규정(무색 도수 안경은 허용)과 달리, 비자 사진에서는 안경을 전혀 착용해서는 안 된다.
glasses.ja: パスポート規定(無色の度付きメガネは許可)とは異なり、ビザ写真ではメガネの着用は一切認められない。

expression.en: Neutral expression with both eyes visible and mouth closed, facing the camera directly.
expression.ko: 양쪽 눈이 보이도록 입을 다물고 무표정으로 카메라를 정면으로 볼 것.
expression.ja: 両目が見えるように口を閉じ、無表情でカメラを正面から見ること。

headwear.en: Head coverings are not accepted, except where the competent State authority specifically approves them for religious, medical, or cultural reasons.
headwear.ko: 관할 국가기관이 종교적·의료적·문화적 사유로 특별히 승인한 경우를 제외하고 머리 가리개는 허용되지 않는다.
headwear.ja: 所轄の国家当局が宗教上・医療上・文化上の理由で特別に承認した場合を除き、頭部の覆いは認められない。

face_visibility.en: Face must occupy 70-80% of the photo's length, facing square to the camera (not at an angle), with both edges of the face clearly visible.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴이 사진 세로 길이의 70~80%를 차지해야 하며, 비스듬하지 않게 카메라를 정면으로 보고 얼굴 양쪽 가장자리가 선명하게 보여야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 顔が写真の縦の長さの70~80%を占める必要があり、斜めではなく正面からカメラを見て、顔の両端がはっきり見える必要がある。

accessories.en: The photo must show the applicant alone, with no other people or objects visible.
accessories.ko: 사진에는 신청자 본인만 나와야 하며, 다른 사람이나 물체가 보이면 안 된다.
accessories.ja: 写真には申請者本人のみが写っている必要があり、他の人物や物体が写っていてはならない。

db_conflicts.research_value: 35mm x 45mm per the official Visa Application Instructions — this is the passport's size (31x41mm), not the visa's. The two document types have different official photo sizes in Trinidad and Tobago.

cross_verification.note_en: Retrieved via curl + pdftotext from foreign.gov.tt (Ministry of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs) and nationalsecurity.gov.tt (Ministry of National Security, Immigration Division) — both official gov.tt domains. The Photograph-Guide-Poster.pdf is directly linked from the official e-Visa Online FAQ page as 'View Photo Specifications', confirming it is the applicable guide for visa photos even though its own text is generic ('Photograph Guide') and co-branded with the printer Canadian Bank Note Company. head_height was deliberately left unverified rather than computed from the poster's 70-80% face-proportion rule, since that rule's exact base dimension for the 35x45mm visa format was not explicitly confirmed in the source text.
